The hermit nods solemnly, "Then I fear you are very late, visitor.  The sun has long since set on these lands, its kings dream beneath the earth, and wind alone reigns in their stead.  It is only well that you'll soon return to your home." He gestures towards the campfire.  " Come, sit here with Naram for a moment, and let us rest and share old tales."
